Satellite name NUTS (NTNU Test Satellite)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 2U
Status cancelled
Organization Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Nation Norway
Oneliner

Educational mission to develop CubeSat platform and possibly IR-camera.
Description

Features: Two transceivers (UHF, VHF); ADCS-system, Robust internal data bus; Robust power supply and system management. Proposed: IR-camera for scientific payload, internal wireless experiment;

Notes

Spin-off: CPT-SCOPE in BEXUS 20, a compact radiation monitor prototype towards a CubeSat-ready energetic particle detector payload using a hybrid approach of COTS and ASIC technology.
